system.description:
From birth your eyes are a clear white, and when manifesting this ability your pupil becomes distinct and the veins around your eyes bulge unnaturally. While manifested you are capable of seeing and processing information in a near 360 degree field around yourself, save for a small blindspot at the back of the neck.

You gain the ability to see through walls or objects; the harder the material the more difficult it is to see through. You may see through a number of feet of loose dirt equal to your Arcane Might. If you are attempting to see through a more durable material, divide the distance you can see through by the Hardness of the material. You cannot see through materials infused with Chakra or magic, such as the smoke produced from a ninja's smoke bomb.

You are able to visually see Chakra and other forms of magic so long as you have the Byakugan active and may use it to detect hidden foes or gain insight about techniques so long as you possess enough knowledge to identify them.

Techniques: All Seeing, Gentle Fist, Hakkesho Kaiten, Hazan Ken.
